lyrics:
[Intro: drum break, horn stabs, clavinet riff]

[Verse 1: energetic male tenor, playful]
Anybody can sing when the check comes through
When the test comes back and the sky is blue
But I got a song with a different trick
It gets louder when the going gets thick

[Chorus: full band, horns, choir answers]
I sing louder on the low days (louder!)
Dance harder on the hard ones (harder!)
When the bottom drops out, that's my cue
I got a song that the dark can't use
Turn it up when it all goes wrong
Louder on the low days

[Verse 2: tenor, bass and drums pushing]
Two men in a jail cell, midnight, beat
Chains on their ankles, stocks on their feet
They started singing like the doors were wide
And the ground shook loose and the locks all died

[Pre-Chorus: horns climbing]
Same song, same reason, same King
The one who walked out of a grave in spring

[Chorus: full band, horns, choir answers]
I sing louder on the low days (louder!)
Dance harder on the hard ones (harder!)
When the bottom drops out, that's my cue
I got a song that the dark can't use
Turn it up when it all goes wrong
Louder on the low days

[Breakdown: drums and claps, call and response]
Who's it for? (Jesus!)
Who rolled the stone? (Jesus!)
Who's still good on a bad day? (Jesus!)
Then what do we do? (Louder!)

[Final Chorus: key up, horns screaming, choir full]
I sing louder on the low days (louder!)
Dance harder on the hard ones (harder!)
When the bottom drops out, that's my cue
I got a song that the dark can't use
Turn it up when it all goes wrong
Louder on the low days

[Outro: horn riff, choir laughing, one last hit]
